description: This Java class 'CustomerServiceImpl' provides implementations for customer-related business logic, including methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting customer data within an e-commerce context. It interacts with DAO components and utility services such as geolocation.

classes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of customer-related business services, handling CRUD operations, address retrieval based on IP, and customer attribute management.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the provided first name.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a Customer object by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Gets the address for a customer based on IP address using geolocation service.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer and associated attributes.
